Cluster PDF font sizes into heading levels and retain bounding boxes

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"application/pdf\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf\"}", "{\"pdf_options\":{\"extract_metadata\":true,\"hierarchy\":{\"enabled\":true,\"include_bbox\":true,\"k_clusters\":6}}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
